subject: english-literature
sourceName: Pearson Edexcel International GCSE English Literature (4ET1) specification

subs: Modern Drama set text (one of: A View from the Bridge; The Curious Incident of the Dog in the Night-time; Kindertransport; Death and the King's Horseman)
AO1: close knowledge and understanding of the play, supported by textual reference
AO2: analysis of language, form and dramatic structure used to create meaning
AO4: understanding of the play and the contexts in which it was written
Modern Prose set text (one of: To Kill a Mockingbird; Of Mice and Men; The Whale Rider; The Joy Luck Club; Things Fall Apart)
AO1: close knowledge and understanding of the novel, maintaining a critical style
AO2: analysis of language, form and structure used by the writer to create meaning
Part 3 of the Pearson Edexcel International GCSE English Anthology (named set poems)
AO1: close knowledge and understanding of the anthology poems
AO2: analysis of language, form and structure used by the poets
AO4: comparison of two anthology poems, exploring links and connections
Analysis of one previously unseen poem (printed in the paper)
AO1: understanding of meaning and the response the poem creates
AO2: analysis of language, form and structure and their effects
